caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of fabric composed of a checkered pattern, centered against a plain, beige background. The checkered swatch consists of alternating squares in blue and reddish-brown colors, forming a grid of three squares by four squares. Each square shows a woven texture, with diagonal lines in blue, reddish-brown, and some off-white tones visible within the pattern, simulating the appearance of threads. The drawing’s composition is simple, with the patterned fabric positioned centrally and ample blank space surrounding it. Near the lower right area of the image, the name "ESTHER MARTINDALE" is faintly written in small, uppercase letters. There are also subtle smudges and faint spots of discoloration on the background.
title: Textile
